To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The welding process is the main source of defects in the transmission line tower.

(i) the welding process is an important factor in the quality of the weld and in the quality of weld metal, (ii) the weld quality is affected by the welding process parameters, and (iii) the quality of welds depends on the quality of welding process.
The use of steel in construction is a sustainable choice because steel is 100% recyclable and the use of recycled steel reduces energy use and CO2 emissions in the production of new steel.

a method to design and manufacture a transmission line tower with high strength, high stiffness and low weight.
a new type of transmission tower which has the characteristics of light weight and high strength, and the design of the tower is presented.
the development and application of the new technology for manufacturing the steel tubular transmission line towers.

, for transmission line steel tubular tower, the girth welding seam is a critical weld.

the welding process of the transmission line tower should be improved to ensure the quality of the welds.

the steel used for tower is the most important factor for the quality of tower, and the welding technology of steel is the key factor for the quality assurance of tower.
the steel tubular tower is a promising structure in transmission line engineering.
